grade_scope.full_positive_basis: All 18 mapped obligations were substantively assessed using the governing brief/frozen plan, final, supplied critique and independent primary inspection. Limits describe planning and evidence applicability; this is not an executed implementation grade.
excluded: Provider/service configuration compliance beyond supplied runtime statement
Unbounded survey of every sync component or source repository

source_correctness.basis: The consequential component, standards, workflow, issue/code/test/release and license claims match independent primary evidence within their declared conditions. N01–N03 preserve wording/metadata limitations. Custom sync properties are assessed as proposed contracts rather than existing component guarantees.

completeness.basis: Every original integrated brief obligation and every supplied substantive critique disposition has been assessed. None was screened out or replaced by a smaller surrogate.

planning_usefulness.basis: The final supplies a coherent tentative architecture, domain decisions, explicit delivery/media/auth/retention semantics, a supervisor review model and observable acceptance gates. Production lock, operation costs and compatibility remain open. The commit-level compaction finding could be translated into a more explicit maintenance/load gate.

breadth.basis: Three materially different sync approaches plus the frozen LWW comparator, one field-data workflow analogue, and the 12 supported discovery clusters below cover the integrated problem. Code-level depth is concentrated in PouchDB compaction; Automerge and native adapter evidence is API/README-level. This is not an exhaustive market or native-stack evaluation.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Choose genuine primary public sources from the user problem
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Official component docs, upstream history, standards and ODK workflow material address offline field work, media, concurrency, authorization and review; no source quality inference from counts or hashes.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Compare at least two materially different mechanisms and important alternatives
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Revision-tree replication, operation-based CRDT documents and application event/outbox processing are separately explained, including why deterministic displayed winners do not supply domain resolution. Timestamp LWW remains the frozen comparator.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Investigate analogous systems beyond direct competitors
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: ODK contributes submission states, review/activity history and missing-media presentation, explicitly as a workflow analogy. It is not credited as a multiwriter asset engine.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Inspect actual component/code behavior at a pinned version
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Read the entire changed PouchDB _compact method and the complete added regression test at the immutable commit; independently inspected release-built code too. The adapter README is commit-pinned guidance, not an executed native build. Other living/unpinned references are honestly labeled.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Trace pertinent issue, fix, regression test and release applicability
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Issue #8525, sequence-filter change and remote-skipping regression match the final. Release notes list the exact fix; compare API reports the fix as merge base with zero behind commits; the release build contains since: opts.last_seq || 0. The test neither measures reported latency/409 frequency nor exercises the mobile stack.

Separate visit evidence from shared current-state fields; keep concurrent alternatives; make resolution a named event with expected heads and stale-screen rejection. Independent-field merge remains a product rule. These are proposed semantics, not library guarantees.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Cover duplicate delivery, retries and lost responses
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Stable identity/bytes, tenant unique key, mismatch rejection, stable receipt and replay-safe projections are explicit. PUT and SQL UPSERT are building blocks only; atomic hash comparison and side effects remain implementation duties.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Cover reordered delivery, pending transitions and recovery cursors
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Missing parents remain pending outside projection; durable state-change feed prevents stranding a cursor. Page/cursor local atomicity, scope binding, expiry, resnapshot and server-restore recovery are specified as design requirements and gates.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Cover retention, deletion and disconnected/restored clients
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Tombstones, physical purge, age horizon and separately governed device/media/export/backup retention are distinguished. External CouchDB purge does not propagate, unlike internal purge replication. No immediate offline erasure promise is made.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Cover access control, identity and attribution
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Server object/action checks cover event feeds, cursors, media, resolution and exports; roles may combine attributes/relationships. Actor claim, device and authenticated submitter stay distinct. Native OAuth advice and offline revocation/storage uncertainty are correctly bounded.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Cover attachment behavior and relevant integration conditions
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Metadata receipt is distinct from verified bytes; stable IDs, size/digest, UI state, independent access and purge are covered. Whole-file retry versus chunks and bytea versus other storage remain measured choices. Range docs support downloads only; Metro caveat is documented guidance, not reproduced compatibility.

All 13 gates were assessed: concurrency, stale resolution, clocks, duplicate/altered retry, pending transitions, cursor crash/expiry, days offline/local failure, media, deletion age, permissions, history/CSV parity, restore/load and records/storage policy. Triggers and expected observable outcomes are clear. Compaction-specific performance deserves a more explicit optional follow-up.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Compare relevant discoveries to frozen plan choices
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: The seven correction rows cover mutable records, timestamp winner, POST/retry identity, path-only photos, latest-only review/export and undefined conflict/delete/auth/audit. Keeping SQLite is justified conditionally. The plan does not explicitly prescribe one record per asset, so that cardinality is a proposed clarification rather than a proven baseline defect.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Support corrections and preserve product/operating choices
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: The leading relational path is conditional on attributable history and utility operations; custom sync/operations costs are disclosed. Field semantics, catalog ownership, correction lifecycle, offline identity, audit level, retention, platform, media, scale and hosting stay open. No unmeasured cost/reliability advantage is asserted.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Preserve useful optional opportunities and justified uncertainties
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Packaged replication, a bounded CRDT spike, ODK workflow ideas, separate GPS observations, chunking, database/object media storage and optional signing remain conditional. Rolling docs, adapter/native compatibility and storage protections are identified uncertainties.

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Provide a complete source-grounded final after supplied criticism and retain dispositions
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Every substantive supplied critique disposition was compared with final text: stale resolution, pending/state-change feed, committed-order cursor, authorization scope changes, canonical bytes/digest limits, tombstone age, local storage/identity limits, preserved mechanisms and open choices. All are retained. Literal draft preservation cannot be reconstructed from the permitted final/critique alone and is outside this input scope.
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.primary_or_governing_evidence: Authorized supplied critique; final source map; independently checked public sources

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Distinguish proposed checks from executed checks
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: The final repeatedly labels prototype checks unexecuted and separates public source/code inspection from installed/mobile/application behavior. The review executed retrieval and document/JSON checks only; it ran no component or application test.
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.primary_or_governing_evidence: Authorized final and critique; static source inspection

per_obligation_evidence_assessment.obligation: Address integrated field-inspection problem with affordable public components and controlled scope
per_obligation_evidence_assessment.evidence_assessment: Days-offline edits, concurrent annotation, photos/GPS, unreliable reconnect, attributable history and supervisor web/CSV review all receive concrete planning treatment. Core license claims are supported; utility-owned hosting is conditional and does not claim free operations or require permanent SaaS. No canon or implementation edits are proposed as executed.

nonmaterial_findings.exact_claim: One mutable inspection record per asset/inspection

counterevidence.finding: The plan says to represent an inspection as a mutable record; it does not explicitly require a single inspection per asset or forbid distinct visit records.

nonmaterial_findings.impact: The per-visit/catalog distinction is useful proposed domain modeling, but this table slightly overstates what the baseline establishes. It does not invalidate rejecting timestamp-only conflict resolution.

nonmaterial_findings.exact_claim: the adapter’s pinned v4.0.0 guidance at commit e269c4300926c16662560ccc1eb68be4f6bfc76b

counterevidence.finding: The pinned package is 4.4.2. Its README says changes apply as of 4.0.0, which is a migration threshold rather than the commit package version.

nonmaterial_findings.impact: The immutable commit identifies the guidance adequately and the final does not lock production to 4.0.0. Clarify the distinction before naming an exact prototype dependency.

nonmaterial_findings.exact_claim: Finalized forms are ready to be sent and can't be edited

counterevidence.locator: Finalized and Sent; independent normalized lines 136 and 143; sources/S15.md
counterevidence.finding: The live primary text has an explicit exception when editing is enabled in the form definition.

nonmaterial_findings.impact: The predecessor bounded excerpt omits that condition. The frozen final only relies on separated states and keeps post-submit correction as an open product choice, so no material final guarantee rests on universal immutability.

followup_limitations.finding: Compaction issue history is pertinent and correctly bounded, but the 13 gates do not name the checkpoint regression/foreground-write maintenance workload expressly; representative load coverage is broader. This limits specificity, not source correctness.

The same CouchDB conflict documentation explains loss of non-leaf bodies on compaction and lack of replicated peer provenance. If that alternative is chosen, full audit needs explicit domain history; the final makes no contrary revision-history guarantee.

The pinned adapter README also describes Hermes design-doc function serialization and an optional SQLCipher key setting. These are reviewer-visible follow-up leads, not additional candidate discoveries or proof of installed encryption. General native/Hermes validation and storage uncertainty remain in the final.

blinding_limits: The exact source-review INPUTS map, brief, frozen plan, own-arm final, supplied critique and authorized source maps/notes were read. No counterpart answer, other arm review, grader, root analysis, candidate costs, native counters or terminal receipts were opened.

The initial instruction-discovery command was overbroad: it enumerated AGENTS.md filenames under PM-Experiments and exposed unrelated historical experiment directory names. No file at those unrelated paths was opened, and those names were not used in the judgment. This is a filename-metadata deviation from strict input isolation, not evidence of scientific comparison.

Treatment and I-ANCHOR-LUNA labels are visible in the supplied paths. Authored output reveals research-v1/critic-finalizer-v1 staging, same-family criticism, and Goal/native-activation wording in its source notes. Public-source retrieval windows/methods are visible; candidate execution time/cost was not inferred from them.

The critique is an authorized prior opinion and was read, so this is independent primary verification with supplied criticism, not blindness to the critic. Its positive disposition was not accepted as evidence of source correctness.

The predecessor draft is mentioned in SOURCES.md but is not an allowed review input; it was not opened. Preservation is assessed against the supplied critique dispositions and final, not a reconstructed draft diff.

The requested runtime is codex_gmail / gpt-6.1-sol / xhigh / priority. The harness attests model and reasoning effort; provider identity, service tier and billing were not inspected or changed. Billing is unknown.
